intro: Nothing in Kroot is locked by order. Pick whichever route matches why you're learning Korean, and follow it stop by stop.

roadmaps.title: Roadmaps
roadmaps.note: Pick one — running both at once is how people stall. Every stop is a link, so jump in wherever you already are.

extras.title: Two things the roadmap doesn't show
extras.note: Neither is a stop on the route — one runs underneath it, the other ends it.

progress.title: How progress works
progress.note: Three things that sound related but move independently.

people.name: Use Korean with people
people.sub: Dramas, travel, friends. Skips the grammar you don't need yet.

exam.name: Reach B2 or pass TOPIK
exam.sub: Grammar in order, nothing skipped. Slower to feel fluent, but it holds up.

review.title: Practice
review.body: Every word you study is scheduled to come back before you'd forget it. You don't track any of this — you just show up and water what's due.

test.title: Promotion test
test.body: The only thing that moves your grade. A word counts once it has survived its first two spaced reviews, so this fills up as you study — you never decide when you're ready.
test.unlocksValue: {words} words of your grade still held, plus {passages} reading passages

effort.title: Tree level 1–120
effort.body: Every session earns XP. Leveling up means time put in — it doesn't change your grade.

ability.title: Grade A1–C2
ability.body: Moves only when you pass a promotion test. That's when your tree changes species.

cosmetic.title: The garden
cosmetic.body: Costumes, skies, and companions from the Shop. Dress-up only, no effect on learning.

footer: Everything here is self-paced — quizzes never block your progress and nothing expires. Come back to this page any time you feel lost.
